verified.title: Verified
verified.description: True only if the account number and phone number both match the same customer.

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.description: True if verification was refused because the customer is not the account holder.

contactId.title: Contact Id
contactId.description: Id of the verified customer. Empty if not verified. Stored automatically for all later steps.

firstName.title: First Name
firstName.description: First name of the verified customer.
